'''Chrobry Głogów''' ({{IPA|pl|ˈxrɔbrɨ ˈɡwɔɡuf}}) is a Polish [[football (soccer)|football]] club based in [[Głogów]], [[Poland]]. It was founded in 1946. The team's official colors are blue, orange, black and green. Chrobry currently competes in [[I liga]], the second tier of Polish league football. The club's name commemorates [[List of Polish monarchs|Polish King]] [[Bolesław I the Brave]] ({{langx|pl|Bolesław I Chrobry}}), who ruled Poland from 992 to 1025.
